hospital.title: Hospital
hospital.intro: Nobody plans to get sick. Practise how health and life cover work. These games don't touch your wallet.
hospital.cover.label: Cover or Cash?
hospital.cover.hint: Three years: buy health cover, or keep the money?
hospital.claims.label: Claim Desk
hospital.claims.hint: Help at the insurance desk: will the plan pay?
hospital.made_up: A made-up plan for this game.
policy.health.name: Health Shield
policy.life.name: Family Umbrella
cover.title: Cover or Cash?
cover.intro.title: Three years, one choice a year
cover.intro.body: Each year you save {{saving}}. At the start of the year, pay {{premium}} for Health Shield, or keep the money and pay every bill yourself.
cover.intro.loan: If a bill is bigger than your savings, you borrow. A loan is paid back with {{pct}}% extra.
cover.rule.title: Health Shield
cover.rule.stay: Hospital stays: the Shield pays {{shield}}%, you pay {{copay}}%.
cover.rule.opd: Clinic visits and chemist medicines: you pay all of it.
cover.term.premium: Premium: what you pay to stay covered, even in a year you never get sick.
cover.term.copay: Co-pay: your own share of a bill the plan covers.
cover.year.repaid: {{money}} of it went to pay back the loan.
cover.line.not_covered: No hospital stay, not covered. You paid {{you}}
cover.other.bought: If you had kept the {{premium}}: savings {{savings}}, owed {{debt}}.
cover.other.skipped: If you had bought Health Shield: savings {{savings}}, owed {{debt}}.
cover.done.title: Three years later
cover.lesson.saved: Health Shield paid {{shield}} of the hospital bill. In quiet years the premium buys nothing you can hold; it stops one bad month becoming a big loan.
cover.lesson.hit: The hospital stay cost {{bill}} and took your savings. With cover, your share would have been {{copay}}.
cover.lesson.hit_loan: The hospital stay cost {{bill}}. Savings ran out, so you borrowed. With cover, your share would have been {{copay}}.
cover.lesson.pool: Most families pay more in premiums than they ever claim. That money pays the bills of the few who get very sick. That is how insurance works.
claims.title: Claim Desk
claims.intro.title: Help at the insurance desk
claims.intro.body: Families bring their bills and ask: will the plan pay? Read the policy card, then decide: covered or not covered.
claims.intro.note: Practice: no money changes hands in this game.
claims.rule.stay: A hospital stay of at least one night: the plan pays {{shield}}%, you pay {{copay}}% (co-pay).
claims.rule.accident: Accidents: covered from the first day.
claims.rule.waiting: Illness in the first {{days}} days after buying: not covered (waiting period).
claims.rule.opd: Clinic visits and chemist medicines without a stay: not covered.
claims.rule.cosmetic: Treatment only for looks: not covered.
claims.rule.lapsed: Premium not paid this year: no cover.
claims.rule.life_paid: If the insured person dies within {{years}} years, the family gets {{money}}.
claims.rule.term_end: If they are alive after {{years}} years, nothing is paid back. That keeps the premium small.
claims.rule.life_lapsed: If the premiums stop, the cover stops.
claims.case.dengue: Dengue. Stayed in hospital for 3 nights. Bought Health Shield 2 years ago.
claims.case.appendix: Appendix operation, 4 nights in hospital. Covered for a year now.
claims.case.bus_accident: Broke an arm in a bus accident, 2 nights in hospital. Bought Health Shield 10 days ago.
claims.case.typhoid_new: Typhoid, 3 nights in hospital. Bought Health Shield 2 weeks ago.
claims.case.cough_clinic: A bad cough. Saw the clinic doctor and went home the same day. Covered for 3 years.
claims.case.chemist: Medicines from the chemist, written on the doctor's slip. No hospital stay.
claims.case.teeth_whitening: Wants whiter teeth for a wedding photo. Covered for 2 years.
claims.case.fever_lapsed: High fever, 2 nights in hospital. Forgot to pay this year's premium.
claims.case.life_paid: Her husband had Family Umbrella and paid every premium. He passed away in an accident last month.
claims.case.term_end: His 20 years of Family Umbrella just ended. He is healthy and asks for his premiums back.
claims.case.life_lapsed: Her brother stopped paying for Family Umbrella 2 years ago. He passed away this year.
claims.why.stay: A hospital stay is covered. Health Shield pays {{policy}}; the family pays {{you}}, the co-pay.
claims.why.accident: Accidents have no waiting period. Health Shield pays {{policy}}; the family pays {{you}}.
claims.why.waiting: The illness began in the first {{days}} days. The waiting period stops people buying cover only once they are already sick.
claims.why.opd: No hospital stay, so Health Shield doesn't pay. Clinic visits and medicines come from your own savings.
claims.why.cosmetic: Treatment just for looks isn't covered. The plan is for illness and injury.
claims.why.lapsed: No premium this year means no cover. When a premium is missed, the plan stops.
claims.why.life_paid: This is what life cover is for. The family gets {{policy}} to help replace the income they lost.
claims.why.term_end: This plan pays only if the person dies within the {{years}} years. He is alive and well, the best outcome, so nothing comes back.
claims.why.life_lapsed: The premiums stopped, so the cover stopped. A life plan protects only while it is paid.
claims.done.title: Desk closed
claims.done.lesson: Read what a plan doesn't pay for before you need it: clinic visits, the waiting period, and what happens if a premium is missed.
claims.done.term: Claim: asking the plan to pay. Waiting period: the first days after buying, when illness isn't covered.
